title: CNI Network Configuration
description: Schema for the Container Network Interface (CNI) network configuration document. This JSON object is passed to a CNI plugin via stdin when the container runtime invokes the plugin to attach (ADD), detach (DEL), or check (CHECK) a container's network interface. The configuration specifies the plugin type, IPAM settings, capabilities, and plugin-specific parameters.

cniVersion.description: The version of the CNI specification this configuration conforms to.

cniVersions.description: List of CNI specification versions this plugin supports, used in VERSION responses.

items.description: A supported CNI spec version string.

name.description: Network name. Must be unique across all network configurations on a host. Used to identify the network when multiple configurations exist.

type.description: Name of the CNI plugin binary to invoke. The container runtime will search for an executable with this name in the configured plugin search path.

args.description: Optional additional arguments provided by the container runtime. The CNI_ARGS environment variable supersedes this field when both are set.

disable-check.description: If true, the runtime will not invoke the CHECK operation for this attachment.

aliases.description: Network-scoped aliases for this container attachment.

ipMasq.description: If true, the plugin should configure IP masquerade (NAT) on the host for traffic leaving the network.

capabilities.description: Map of capability names to boolean values indicating which runtime capabilities this plugin supports. Used by the runtime to determine which well-known fields to pass in runtimeConfig.

mac.description: Plugin supports explicit MAC address assignment.

deviceID.description: Plugin supports device ID assignment for SR-IOV.

runtimeConfig.description: Runtime-injected configuration values corresponding to the declared capabilities. Populated by the container runtime with per-attachment values such as port mappings.

portMappings.description: List of port mappings to configure, if portMappings capability is set.

mac.description: Explicit MAC address to assign to the container interface.

ipRanges.description: IP address ranges from which the IPAM plugin should allocate an address.

IPAM.description: IP Address Management (IPAM) plugin configuration. Specifies the IPAM plugin to use and its configuration for allocating IP addresses to the container interface.

type.description: Name of the IPAM plugin binary to invoke for address allocation.

subnet.description: CIDR notation subnet from which to allocate IP addresses (used by host-local plugin).

rangeStart.description: First IP address in the allocation range. Must be within the subnet.

rangeEnd.description: Last IP address in the allocation range. Must be within the subnet.

gateway.description: Gateway IP address for the subnet. Assigned to the host-side interface.

routes.description: List of routes to add to the container network namespace.

dataDir.description: Directory used by host-local plugin to store IP allocation state.

resolvConf.description: Path to a resolv.conf file to use for DHCP DNS configuration.

ranges.description: Multiple IP address ranges for allocation. Each inner array is a set of ranges sharing the same subnet.

DNS.description: DNS configuration to apply to the container network namespace.

nameservers.description: List of DNS nameserver IP addresses in priority order.

items.description: IP address of a DNS nameserver.

domain.description: Local domain name for short hostname lookups.

search.description: DNS search domains for hostname resolution.

options.description: DNS resolver options as a list of option strings.

items.description: A resolver option string, e.g. 'ndots:5' or 'single-request'.

Route.description: A network route to add in the container network namespace.

gw.description: Next-hop gateway IP address for this route. If omitted, uses the subnet gateway.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for this route.

advmss.description: Advertised maximum segment size for TCP connections on this route.

IPRange.description: An IP address range for IPAM allocation with optional gateway and subnet constraints.

subnet.description: CIDR subnet this range belongs to.

rangeStart.description: First usable IP address in this range.

rangeEnd.description: Last usable IP address in this range.

gateway.description: Gateway IP address for this range.

PortMapping.description: A port mapping rule forwarding traffic from a host port to a container port.

hostPort.description: Port number on the host to map from.

protocol.description: IP protocol for this port mapping.

hostIP.description: Host IP address to bind this port mapping to. If empty, binds to all interfaces.

BandwidthEntry.description: Traffic bandwidth limits for the container interface, applied using the Linux traffic control subsystem.

ingressRate.description: Ingress (download) rate limit in bits per second.

ingressBurst.description: Ingress burst size in bits. The maximum amount of traffic allowed to burst above the rate limit.

egressRate.description: Egress (upload) rate limit in bits per second.

egressBurst.description: Egress burst size in bits. The maximum amount of traffic allowed to burst above the rate limit.

Result.description: The CNI result object returned by a plugin after a successful ADD operation, or passed as prevResult to subsequent plugins in a chain. Contains the assigned interfaces, IP addresses, routes, and DNS configuration.

cniVersion.description: The CNI specification version of this result.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces created or configured by this plugin.

ips.description: List of IP addresses assigned to the container's network interfaces.

routes.description: List of routes added in the container network namespace.

Interface.description: A network interface created or configured by a CNI plugin.

name.description: Name of the network interface, e.g. 'eth0' or 'veth1234abcd'.

mtu.description: MTU of the interface in bytes.

sandbox.description: Path to the network namespace containing this interface. Empty for host-side interfaces.

socketPath.description: Path to a socket for plugins that communicate via a Unix domain socket.

pciID.description: PCI ID of the device underlying this interface, used for SR-IOV.

IPConfig.description: An IP address configuration assigned to a container interface.

address.description: IP address and prefix length in CIDR notation assigned to the interface.

gateway.description: Default gateway IP address for this address.

interface.description: Index into the interfaces array identifying which interface this IP is assigned to.
